podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Career Shift
podcast.body: Greg Nori was a member of the band Treble Charger for decades, but has since diversified into band management and production. "Greg has been a member of treble charger for decades but now he's branched off into band management and production."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Launching Sum 41's Career
podcast.body: Nori is credited with launching the career of Sum 41 and producing their multi-million selling records. "He's responsible for launching some 41's career and all those multimillion selling some 41 records produced by Greg Norrie."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Residency
podcast.body: Greg Nori has chosen to remain in Canada. "Some like Chad and Greg and Arnold have elected to remain in Canada."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Soundtrack Production
podcast.body: Greg Nori has produced tracks for major film soundtracks, including "Spider-Man" and "Daredevil." "is also produced tracks for Big Soundtracks like Spider-Man and Daredevil."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
